SOURCE: NIST SP 800-34 Rev. 1, Contingency Planning Guide for Federal
Information Systems. PDF from nvlpubs.nist.gov, retrieved 2026-09-04, text

requirements.requirement: Each system component within the plan's scope is tested to confirm the accuracy of its individual recovery procedures.
requirements.source_quote: Each information system component should be tested to confirm the accuracy of individual recovery procedures.

requirements.requirement: Testing is conducted in as close to an operating environment as possible.
requirements.source_quote: Testing can take on several forms and accomplish several objectives but should be conducted in as close to an operating environment as possible.

requirements.requirement: The plan is reviewed and updated regularly as part of the organisation's change management process.
requirements.source_quote: it is essential that the ISCP be reviewed and updated regularly as part of the organization

requirements.requirement: The plan states activation criteria, and the designated authority who activates it when a criterion is met.
requirements.source_quote: The ISCP should be activated if one or more of the activation criteria for that system are met.

requirements.requirement: The plan defines a recovery time objective for each system resource in its scope.
requirements.source_quote: RTO defines the maximum amount of time that a system resource can remain unavailable before there is an unacceptable impact on other system resources

requirements.requirement: The plan defines a recovery point objective stating the point in time to which data must be recoverable after an outage.
requirements.source_quote: The RPO represents the point in time, prior to a disruption or system outage, to which mission/business process data can be recovered
